correctness.rationale: The integral reduced Świątkowski comparison is established by An–Drummond-Cole–Knudsen, arxiv:1708.02351 Theorem 4.5, Definition 4.7, Proposition 4.9. Exact reproducible chain ranks are (364,1248,1344,448); both compositions are zero; D2 and D3 undergo respectively 879 and 448 unimodular ±1 pivots leaving zero residual, so both images are saturated. Connectedness gives rank D1=363 and H0=Z. Hence H1=Z^6, H2=Z^17 and H3=0, no torsion. The attached standalone code reconstructs and checks all critical arithmetic.

value.rationale: The 1-skeleton of the 3-cube is the smallest canonical trivalent cubical network with multiple cycles and is directly motivated by collision-free motion planning of three unlabeled agents. The complete integral H2 rank 17 and absence of torsion/higher homology are natural invariants beyond first-homology formulas or generator theorems; the classification is exact, not an arbitrary graph slice or tiny numerical perturbation. Does not pretend to solve any family or cohomology ring question.
